title: CVSD-Reg: Cross-Modal Visual Semantic Prior Distillation for Robust LiDAR Registration
abstract: arXiv:2608.19536v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning-based global point cloud registration has achieved remarkable progress, yet its reliance on geometric representations makes existing methods sensitive to variations in point density, scan pattern, viewpoint, and sensor characteristics. We propose CVSD-Reg, a robust global LiDAR registration framework that distills visual semantic priors from a vision foundation model into LiDAR representations. In Stage 1, a Point Transformer V3 student learns from a frozen DINOv2 teacher through contrastive distillation and spherical-manifold alignment, which preserves the hyperspherical geometry of the teacher embedding space. Self-supervised InfoNCE consistency and soft $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ invariance further encourage viewpoint-robust descriptors. translated_abstract: 基于学习的全局点云配准已取得显著进展，但其对几何表示的依赖使得现有方法对点密度、扫描模式、视角和传感器特性的变化敏感。我们提出CVSD-Reg，一种鲁棒的全局激光雷达配准框架，将视觉基础模型中的视觉语义先验蒸馏到激光雷达表示中。在第一阶段，一个Point Transformer V3学生模型通过对比蒸馏和球面流形对齐，从冻结的DINOv2教师模型中学习，从而保留教师嵌入空间的超球面几何。自监督InfoNCE一致性和软性SE(3)不变性进一步促进视角鲁棒的描述符。在第二阶段，蒸馏后的表示通过对应学习、密度感知点丢弃增强和端到端姿态优化来适应配准任务。凭借单个检查点...
tldr: 该论文提出CVSD-Reg框架，通过从视觉基础模型蒸馏语义先验到激光雷达表示，增强了配准对点密度、扫描模式和视角变化的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CVSD-Reg, a framework that distills visual semantic priors from a vision foundation model into LiDAR representations to enhance registration robustness against variations in point density, scan pattern, and viewpoint.
